seo.title: Content in Commerce, the Live Commerce Show
seo.meta_description: A monthly live show where commerce teams see their site and HubSpot setup audited on screen and get straight answers on getting found by buyers and AI engines. Next episode August 5 with Portal IQ.

form.trust_text: Live every month, free every time.

hero.title: Watch commerce audits, live.
hero.subtitle: Content in Commerce is our monthly live show. Every episode we put a commerce or HubSpot setup on the screen and fix what is costing the business traffic, leads, and sales. You watch the work happen, ask questions live, and leave with changes you can act on.

sections.title: Next episode, August 5 with Portal IQ
content: Portal IQ, a HubSpot Gold partner, joins us to audit a live HubSpot portal on screen and show how to get found by buyers and AI engines.
Free to attend, with two free audits for everyone who signs up.

sections.title: What every episode gives you
content: The same format every month, built to be useful, not theoretical.
A live audit on screen. We put a portal or store on screen and walk through it in full, so you see real problems found in the moment, not a rehearsed demo.
Your questions, answered. Bring your own setup and your questions, and we take them live during the session and work through them on air.
Fixes you can act on. You leave with a short list of changes to make, and it is a working session, not a sales pitch.

sections.title: New episode every month
content: After August we go live every month with a new guest and a new commerce teardown. Get on the list and we will send you each invite.

items.question: When is the next episode?
items.answer: August 5 at 2 PM Eastern, live with Portal IQ. After that, a new episode every month.

items.question: Is it free?
items.answer: Yes. Every episode is free to attend, and the August 5 session includes two free audits for anyone who signs up.

items.question: Who is it for?
items.answer: Commerce operators, marketers, and founders who want to see how their site or HubSpot portal performs for buyers and AI search.

items.question: Will it be recorded?
items.answer: Yes. Register and we will send you the recording even if you cannot make it live.
